intro: A written missive delivered to aspiring orc shamans in the Valley of Trials. Penned by the trainer Shikrik and handed out by Gornek, it calls initiates to embrace their role as spiritual leaders and conduits for the elemental spirits.

p: Within the sun-baked canyon of the Valley of Trials, new orc shamans begin their training under the watchful gaze of veteran overseers. While performing initial trials for Gornek, an initiate is handed this rune-covered document. Sent directly by Shikrik, the local shamanic instructor, the parchment serves as a formal summons into the deeper mysteries of elemental communion. Orcish culture regards the shaman not merely as a battlefield spellcaster, but as an essential mediator between the living and the ancestors. This brief writ marks the transition from simple brute strength to the disciplined path of ancestral reverence.
